intent: The keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end of a CommandItem.
typical_uses: The key combination that runs the same command outside the list

dont_use_when.situation: A key or key combination shown in running text or a tooltip, outside a command row

invariants.text: The shortcut is text only: it registers no key handler and adds no `aria-keyshortcuts`, so the application binds the keys itself.
command.module.css pushes the shortcut to the inline end of its row and renders it in the muted foreground color, switching to the accent foreground while the CommandItem holding it is highlighted.

good.title: A shortcut hint on a command

bad.title: A shortcut placed as its own row in the list
bad.why: The shortcut belongs inside the item whose command it names; on its own in the list it is not tied to any item and is not hidden when that item is filtered out.
